description_full: Shinhan Financial Group Co., Ltd. provides financial products and services in South Korea and overseas. It offers credit, lending and receiving deposits; credit cards, short-term and long-term card loan services, installment financing, and leases; securities trading, consignment trading, and underwriting; life and non-life insurance business; facility rental and new technology business financing; and real estate trust, investment advisory services, venture business investment, and other businesses. Shinhan Financial Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1982 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.

financial_summary: Shinhan Financial Group Co Ltd is a large-cap financial services business with a $29.4B market cap on $54.4B of annual revenue.
Returns on capital run at 4% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.

The business throws off $3.2B in free cash flow — roughly 6 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.01× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 6.0× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss, and thin 0.4× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 2.4% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome, and profit capture is only 0.3× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
